items.title: What the Whiteboard is for
items.content:
What goes here

Anything that doesn't fit the other tabs: a printable sign-in sheet, a design brief, meeting notes, a snippet you want linkable and shareable. Paste HTML directly (a full <!doctype html> document is shown as a printable; a fragment gets the board's own styling automatically).

Add one with the "+ New item" button, or from the command line with osctl.mjs note "Title" "<p>content</p>".
